narrative:
Material PL1__MB2892F9 exhibits regular demand with a coefficient of variation of 0.31. 
The demand pattern follows a gamma-like distribution with mean daily demand of 559.3 units.
Lead time shows moderate variability (CV=0.38) with mean 2.92 days.

The analysis reveals that lead time variability is the dominant source of uncertainty (82%), 
driving safety stock requirements. 

Current SAP policy (safety stock=0, order qty=426) results in excessive ordering frequency 
(328 orders/year) and high ordering costs ($16410).

Recommended policy increases safety stock to 1144 units and order quantity to 3535 units, 
achieving 95% service level while reducing total annual costs by 76.5% ($12654 savings).

The order quantity is constrained by maximum storage capacity (4679 units), 
limiting it below the optimal EOQ of 4606 units. Despite this constraint, significant cost 
reductions are achievable through better inventory management.
warnings: Order quantity constrained by capacity from 4607 to 3535

research_insights.selection_rationale: Regular demand pattern (CV=0.31) with moderate lead time variability (CV=0.38) suits classic reorder point model
research_insights.boundary_risk: Order quantity constrained by storage capacity; optimal EOQ not achievable
